author: one_washer_forty_floors
title: AITA for getting banned from my building's laundry room after I moved a stranger's washing?
text: My building has one washer, forty apartments, and no rules. Last Sunday I waited two hours for a load that had already finished. So I moved the wet clothes into a neat pile and started mine. Ten minutes later the owner came down screaming that I had touched her delicates. I told her I had folded them, which was technically true. She reported me to the landlord, and he banned me from the laundry room for a week. Today he also installed a sign that says the machines work first come, first serve, which is all any of us have wanted for a year. So I lost my laundry privileges and got the whole floor the rules it needed. Am I the asshole?
